page.running_head: De Agro Frisi. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: præter ea nihil se statutorum in societatibus suis habere: præterea, si quæ societas civitati inutilis aut noxia videatur, in potestate senatus esse, eam abrogare: item, si quis in societate quid committat, quo se indignum societate fecisse videatur, deque eo controversia existat, ejus cognitionem senatui deberi cum tribus societatis præfectis: ad hæc, societates cum præfectis suis teneri, summa ope, summis viribus ut tueantur dignitatem & jus senatus, eique auxilio & firmamento sint, ac pœnas contumacium, cum res requirit, promoveant. Habent tamen societatum præfecti in suâ quisque societate potestatem cognoscendi controversias quasdam ad societatem pertinentes, easque definiendi, ac multas quoque capiendi ab his, qui contra societatis leges deliquisse deprehenduntur. Sed id totum sic habet, ut jurisdictionis species aut pars videri nequeat.
Et si quis eo lædi se injuste à præfectis existimet, is pro more Ædiles, tanquam societatum summos magistros atque ἐφό-ρους[?] appellat, ab his porrò, si placet, ad ipsum

page.notes: Catchword "ipsum" is printed as "ipsutn"; the final letters are doubtful, hence [?]. The Greek word at the line end is printed "ἐφό-" with the continuation "ρυς" on the scan; read as ἐφόρους, marked [?]. The paragraph break before "Et si quis" is inferred from the sentence end and the flush-left line start; the line "nequeat." is near full width, so this break is not fully certain. The scan has a Google digitisation watermark at the lower right and a small mark at the bottom centre; both are excluded. "cum" in "cum res" appears to carry a faint mark above the u; read as plain cum.
